name: 5000 Rummy
description: 5000 Rummy is a rummy card game that involves melding, sets, runs. The game originated in North America and has become popular worldwide.

content.text: 5000 Rummy is a rummy card game that involves melding, sets, runs. The game originated in North America and has become popular worldwide.

North American rummy; many house variants (no two descriptions agree). Named for common target score 5000; also played to 1500, 2000, 2500, 10000. Related to 500 Rummy but with different draw and scoring.
3–4 typically (2–8 with one or two decks). Deal and play clockwise.
52 cards (3–4p); 104 (two packs) for 5–8p. Deal whole hands at once per player.
Deck(s); score sheet to 5000 (or agreed target).
Dealer gives each player their full hand before next player; first dealer by low card.

items.text: Target score variants (1500–10000): Groups may play to alternative targets such as 1500, 2000, 2200, 2500, 2800 or 10000 instead of 5000; rules of play stay the same but the game length and pacing change with the chosen goal.

Permanent wild cards and jokers: Some groups treat certain ranks (often twos) or added jokers as permanent wild cards worth high points, sometimes adjusting hand sizes or extra cards when a permanent wild appears as the upcard.

George / 2500 Rummy (sets only): In the George / 2500 Rummy family, only sets of equal cards may be melded, runs are not allowed, and stricter conditions apply when taking multiple cards from the discard pile.
